prompt:
Create a production-ready BACKGROUND PLATE for a Canvas 2D side-scrolling Sun Wukong action game. This is an asset derived from the reference game concept, not a finished screenshot. Use the reference ONLY for the Chinese celestial architecture, palette, fine hand-painted detail and light.
Output a very wide panoramic image with approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. View from the SIDE high above an endless cloud ocean. UPPER 70% bright hazy celadon sky, distant blue floating mountains and small palaces, long layered white clouds. Several medium-distance floating Chinese celestial palaces with deep jade-blue roofs, thin golden roof ridges, vermilion pillars and bridges; the Southern Heavenly Gate is a large elegant architectural landmark in the RIGHT THIRD, behind the action plane, with a readable "南天门" plaque if visible. LOWER 30% is soft white and pale turquoise CLOUD SEA ONLY, quiet and low-detail. Gold morning sunlight from upper right. Atmospheric contrast and texture rich but background values kept soft; silhouetted gameplay actors drawn later must stand out.
Critical exclusions: NO characters, NO Sun Wukong, NO people, NO soldiers, NO staff, NO weapons, NO UI or HUD, NO text other than optional gate plaque, NO title, NO frames, NO foreground pillars or foreground buildings, NO foreground walkable ground, NO floor, NO foreground platform or terrace or railing. This is scenery BEHIND separate procedural solid platforms.
Premium hand-painted Chinese gongbi-inspired fantasy, architecture beautifully detailed at distance, coherent cloud world with readable empty space for gameplay in lower half. Not photorealism, not pixel art, no watermarks.
